'''Ashur Sungazer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Historian/Legends|scholar]] specializing in [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] History at [[Phelar University]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. He had a special interest in the history and legends of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
Ashur Sungazer was a small child at the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], so his entire memories in life have been during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Yet from a young age he became interested in legends about the fallen [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which he had been raised to believe as myths. As a young man, he traveled on many expeditions, scouring the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] for information. In spite of Imperial [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] that portrayed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as delusional or simply frauds, deep down, Sungazer wanted to believe in the noble legends of the Jedi as guardians of peace and justice in the galaxy.
